result:
All research is complete. Here are the answers:

---

**h01** — `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, with an immediate run at startup) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:153`, runner created at line 162, `RunOnce` at line 163, goroutine at line 166)

**h02** — delivery function: `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (async path via `PostAsync` at line 184 enqueues to a buffered channel drained by 4 worker goroutines calling `Post`); protection mechanism: `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` resolves DNS and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP` + reserved CIDRs at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-54`, plus `ValidateURL` at `validate.go:62` checks at webhook creation time

**h03** — abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go` defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go` provides the concrete OAuth2 `IdentityProvider`)

**h04** — No; `mysql.NewDB` is called only from the factory `NewDBDriver` at `store/db/db.go:22`. Grep for `mysql.NewDB`, `mysql.DB{`, `&mysql.DB{` across the entire codebase returns zero hits outside the factory. No struct-literal construction exists anywhere.

**h05** — Explicit Go code; reactions are removed by two SQL DELETE statements in the user-deletion transaction: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (deletes reactions on the user's memos, e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96`) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (deletes reactions by the user, e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:102`). Same pattern in all three drivers (sqlite, mysql, postgres). The `reaction` table has no foreign key constraints or CASCADE rules (confirmed in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`).

**h06** — `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`); convergence function: `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`

**h07** —
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `driver.ListUsers` (e.g. `sqlite.DB.ListUsers`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`

The avatar is stored as a base64 data URI in the `avatar_url` column; `serveUserAvatar` decodes it via `parseDataURI` (fileserver.go:737) and serves the bytes.

**h08** —
- `memopayload.Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — not invoked from production code — no caller
- `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43`) — invoked — callers: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:163`) and its own `Run` method (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)

**h09** — 6 distinct declarations: `SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`), `Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`). All 6 are called from production code: `SSEHub.Close` via `Server.closeLongLivedConnections` (`server/server.go:206`); `Store.Close` via `Server.Shutdown` (`server/server.go:146`); `Cache.Close` via `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:74-76`); the three `DB.Close` methods via `s.driver.Close()` in `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:78`) through the `Driver` interface.

**h10** — `GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40` — approx fan-in ~28 (7 production + 21 test call sites)

**h11** — 1st: `User` (~7 packages); 2nd: `Memo` (~7 packages, though `User` has more total reference sites). `Attachment` is 3rd at ~5 packages.

**h12** — `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`; determined by tracing the default: `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, which feeds `NewDBDriver` at `store/db/db.go:18-20` to select `sqlite.NewDB`, so only the SQLite driver's `CreateMemo` runs.

**h13** — impl: `*markdown.service` (unexported, `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`); construction: `markdown.NewService()` called once in `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`); holders: `APIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `Runner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`)

**h14** — computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) delegates to `markdown.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`); snippet computed by `getMemoContentSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83`) calling `GenerateSnippet` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:264`). Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` content path (`memo_service.go:447`), and batch `Runner.RunOnce` (`memopayload/runner.go:27`). Extracted properties: `Tags` (hashtags), `Property.HasLink`, `Property.HasTaskList`, `Property.HasCode`, `Property.HasIncompleteTasks`, `Property.Title` (first H1), and `Snippet` (plain-text preview, max 64 chars).

**h15** —
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (used by `GetMemo`, `ListMemoComments`) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query-time visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218`
- `ListMemoReactions` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82`
- `ListMemoAttachments` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:419`
- File server `checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:649`
- SSE hub `canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- RSS feed (PUBLIC-only filter) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- Frontend sitemap (PUBLIC-only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- `CreateMemoComment` inline check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33`

**r01** — False premise. Redis is not used. The cache layer is a pure in-memory `sync.Map` implementation at `store/cache/cache.go` with a default TTL of 10 minutes (`DefaultConfig()` at line 56).

**r02** — False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The only middleware is `Recover()` and CORS (`server/server.go:51-52`).

**r03** — False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler/` package exists as library code but is never imported or used by the server. The only background runner is the S3 presign refresher.

**r04** — False premise. Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, defined at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:31`) drained by 4 goroutines that call `webhook.Post` directly over HTTP.

**r05** — False premise. GraphQL is not used. The public API is gRPC + Connect (connectrpc.com/connect) with gRPC-Gateway for REST/JSON. Protocol Buffer definitions are in `proto/api/v1/`, Connect handlers registered at `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:34`, and gRPC-Gateway at `server/server.go:88`.
